summary: Enhance your IT career with our Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central training. Get practical insights and tools to optimize business processes effectively.
lede: Business Central training helps IT professionals govern ERP environments, manage access, and connect business data with enterprise systems. For administrators, architects, and technical consultants, it covers configuring environments, designing API integrations, validating migrated data, and monitoring operational health so teams can support controlled changes and reliable operations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for IT professionals who support, administer, integrate, extend, or govern Business Central environments and need a practical bridge between ERP configuration and enterprise technology operations.
modules: Business Central Security and Access Control
Business Central APIs and Integration Design
Business Central Data Migration and Quality
Business Central DevOps and Release Management
Business Central Operating Roadmap and Reporting
prerequisites: Working knowledge of enterprise IT operations, cloud services, ERP concepts, and relational data is expected. Experience with Business Central administration, Microsoft Entra ID, REST APIs, or Power Platform is useful but not mandatory. Basic AL familiarity helps with extension discussions, but advanced programming is not required for completion. Labs use representative Business Central environments and supplied datasets. You need a laptop and browser access; production tenant credentials are not required.
